text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Based on the track conditions and other 
factors, the Trainer concluded it was 
impossible for me to beat Taiki in the 
Prix Jacques Le Marois...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I felt that because Taiki and the Prix 
Jacques le Marois share a strong destiny, 
I couldn't win. The answer is... the same, 
yes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
“Yet we've found another route! We may 
concede our European GⅠ breakthrough for 
now, but mark my words, we'll overtake you 
down the line!”

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To do that, I'll be waiting to challenge 
Taiki at the Sprinters Stakes the moment 
she returns!
